Explain in three sentences what a storyboard is, with an example from an ad
text., com um exemplo de anúncio: , with an example from an ad
text.Um **storyboard** é a sequência de desen: A **storyboard** is the sequence of drawings that shows, frame by frame, how a video will look before it is shot. Each frame shows the framing, the action and, often, the dialogue or the sound of the scene. It helps the team plan the shots, foresee problems and save time on the shoot.
text.Pense no storyboard como uma história em: Think of the storyboard as a comic strip of your video. Each frame draws one shot: who appears, where the camera is and what happens. That way, everyone sees the finished film before the first day of shooting.
text.Um storyboard é o roteiro em imagens: ca: A storyboard is the script in pictures: each frame shows one shot of the video. In a 15-second coffee ad, that would be about four frames: the steaming cup, the hand that picks it up, the first sip and the logo at the end. With that, the team knows exactly what to shoot and in what order.
